# src/connector-ui/src/components

Layer **ui** · project `connector-ui` · UI components: 67

Project navigation: [connector-ui](../projects/connector-ui-f36e97198b9e.md)

## Overview 🤖

Contains Vue.js components for the Connector UI, including forms, tables, and cards for managing exports and imports.

**Responsibilities.** Manages the user interface for export and import operations, including previewing, editing, and running export and import definitions.

**Usage.** Used by the Connector UI views to render components for managing exports and imports.

_AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself._

## Key components

| Component | Kind | Used by | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [StatusBadge](#statusbadge) | component | 7 | Data-driven instead of a switch/ternary chain: a status maps to one (icon, color) pair here, and every consumer — export runs, export/import definition runs, import-run four-eyes review — funnels through the same table rather than each growing its own branch. |
| [SuggestedRelations](#suggestedrelations) | component | 4 |  |
| [AppVersion](#appversion) | component | 2 | Comes from the running API, not baked into the bundle, so it shows what the container actually runs even if the browser still has an older index.html cached. |
| [ExportFormatPicker](#exportformatpicker) | component | 2 |  |
| [ExportNodeMappingEditor](#exportnodemappingeditor) | component | 2 | Inline editor for one scalar-field node's FieldMapping: rename is the node's own TargetKey input (owned by the caller), so this only covers the four FieldMapping members — transform, transform argument, null-fallback, and data-type coercion target. Mirrors Connector.Core.DynamicExport.FieldTransform/FieldDataType exactly (see ExportNode.cs) so every value this can emit is one the backend validator already accepts. |
| [FieldPickerTable](#fieldpickertable) | component | 2 | Shared by RelationCard and NestedGroupEditor — both need an identical checkbox+rename table over "columns of a related table", differing only in which property holds the rename (relations call it targetField, nested groups call it targetKey). `targetProp` picks that property type-safely per caller instead of forcing the two mapping shapes to match. |
| [ImportPlanDiffTable](#importplandifftable) | component | 2 | Shared by ImportDefinitionPreviewPanel.vue (a sample-file preview) and ImportRunReviewDialog.vue (a staged run's four-eyes review) — both need the same "one row's changed fields, grouped by CorrelationValue" rendering of a plan's operations as a field-level diff. PlanJson is the write-side source of truth; this component only ever displays operations handed to it, never recomputes anything. |
| [JobRowActions](#jobrowactions) | component | 2 | The per-row actions of the Export Jobs and Import Jobs lists: open (Edit, or View without the edit permission), then Test, Duplicate and Delete (with confirm), each shown only when the parent allows it. |

_component_ · [ExportDefinitionPreviewPanel.vue](../../src/connector-ui/src/components/ExportDefinitionPreviewPanel.vue#L1)

### ExportNodeFieldEditor

_component_ · [ExportNodeFieldEditor.vue](../../src/connector-ui/src/components/ExportNodeFieldEditor.vue#L1)

Self-referencing recursive component (see NestedGroupEditor.vue for the same pattern applied to the legacy mapping shape). Deliberately a flat, read-the-identifiers-and-fix-them form — not a tree builder: it edits SourceField/RelatedTable/JoinKey/SourceJoinKey and the Enabled flag on the existing tree in place, but never adds, removes, or re-kinds a node. That's enough to point a migrated definition at real production table/column names; building/restructuring the tree is ExportNodeTreeEditor.vue's job, not this recovery form's.

Props: nodes: ExportNode[], depth: number

### ExportNodeTreeEditor

_component_ · [ExportNodeTreeEditor.vue](../../src/connector-ui/src/components/ExportNodeTreeEditor.vue#L1)

The export definition tree builder: the single recursive editor for every ExportNode kind ("scalar-field" | "object" | "array"), in every output format. Used as the definition editor's tree UI once a definition has real columns to build from (otherwise see ExportNodeFieldEditor.vue). Structurally mirrors NestedGroupEditor.vue (the legacy MappingNestedGroup tree editor) but is kept as its own component: the two operate on different, incompatible tree shapes (MappingNestedGroup's flat per-group `fields` list vs. ExportNode's uniform recursive `children`), and NestedGroupEditor.vue serves only the legacy `/export-schema` flow.

Props: nodes: ExportNode[], contextTable: string, availableTables: SourceTable[], depth: number
